Name: Hot Clint
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
A few days ago, someone shared an edited version of K2sync's version of Clint (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4615]here[/url]) but no one could fine it. But permissions for the mod were open and our motto in the modding community is be the change you want to see, right? And so was born...HOT CLINT.

This mod is available for both vanilla and Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic. For vanilla, just install the vanilla file. For Seasonal Cute, overwrite your Seasonal cute folder with the one provided in the download. 

I recommend pairing this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28753]Clint Narrative Overhaul[/url] for an all-around better Clint experience :)

Enjoy this mod nobody asked for!

Edit: As of 1.2, this is now compatible with Clint Reforged and Looking for Love! Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/118355513]SoftPandaBoi[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/143742733]mushroomhash[/url] for permissions to add compatibility! 

EDIT 2: As of 2.0, the code has been cleaned up and condensed all into one file thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url]! Hot Clint can now be installed with just the one file and will work with Vanilla, SVE, Clint Reforged, Seasonal Cute, and Looking for Love all from the one file!
